info.description:
API Tanami: autentikasi, lahan dan tanaman, scan penyakit dan kematangan,
riwayat, cuaca BMKG, reminder, forum, moderasi, dan basis pengetahuan penyakit.

Semua respons memakai amplop `{"data": ...}`. Galat memakai
`{"error": {"code", "message", "details", "request_id"}}` dengan `message`
berbahasa Indonesia yang layak ditampilkan ke pengguna.
info.title: Tanami API

get.description: Every disease, including ones taken out of the catalogue.

patch.description: Edit reviewed content; the editor and today's date become the review stamp.

get.description: Counts for the staff dashboard. Aggregates only, no personal data.
Team announcements already sent, newest first, with read counts.
Search accounts by name, username or email, newest first.
``active``: Daftar Tanaman Deteksi. ``ended``: History Deteksi Penyakit.
Detail with every check (photo, disease, confidence, symptoms, advice).

post.description:
Register or re-point an FCM token.

``fcm_token`` is globally unique. When someone else logs in on the same
handset the token must move accounts, otherwise pushes for the previous user
keep arriving.

get.description: Published posts, newest first, filterable by commodity and free text.

Everything the Beranda screen needs in one round trip.

A weather outage must not blank the screen, so the forecast is optional
here; the app shows the rest and labels the weather panel as unavailable.
Reported content awaiting review, oldest first.

post.description: ``dismiss`` republishes, ``hide`` keeps it hidden, ``remove`` deletes it.

get.description: Dropdown of plant types (requirement 1); detection works for some only.

delete.description: Shorthand for ending tracking with reason ``other`` (design 10.5).

post.description: A care action; ``action=watering`` is the watering history (requirement 2).
Requirement 1: end tracking; reminders for this plant stop.
Growth photo (requirement 1); EXIF and GPS are stripped like scans.

get.description:
Merged, newest-first events for one plant.

The events come from three tables, so the cursor is applied to the merged
in-memory list rather than to a single SQL query. ``limit`` bounds the page.

post.description:
Analyse one photo.

``201`` for a new scan. A resend with the same ``client_uuid`` returns the
stored result with ``200`` and never calls the vision service again
(design 10.6, 14); ``is_duplicate`` carries the same information in the body.

get.description: Detail Scan (S12), including the user's verdict if they gave one.

post.description:
One photo for a forum post.

Same validation as a scan upload - content sniffing, size and dimension
limits, EXIF stripped by re-encoding - because it comes from the same camera
roll and TQA 9 does not exempt uploads to the community tab.

Change the password; every other device is logged out (TQA 9).

The response carries a fresh token pair so this device stays signed in.

get.description: Liveness: answers even while PostgreSQL is down.
Readiness: every hard dependency must answer.
